answer.evidence: Step Rx drop of ~2.75dB on 22 Oct coinciding with crew re-entry into SC-05 (22:33), OTDR shows single non-reflective step at fibre 18.753km from A / 2.796km from B = SC-05 (route 18.254km after fibre-excess conversion). Bidirectional-average loss rises steeply with wavelength: 0.51dB @1310, 2.81dB @1550, ~4.9dB @1625 — diagnostic of macrobend, not a bad splice. TX healthy (1.18dBm, stable bias/power), attenuator 7.14dB = design 7dB, connectors clean with ~0.2dB loss, SC-02 gainer/loss pair cancels bidirectionally (normal G.652/G.655 MFD mismatch). Excess link loss 2.74dB matches the 2.81dB 1550nm event. Corrective action: open SC-05, relieve the tight bend in the stored slack and re-coil correctly.

transcript.content: Both ODF end-faces are clean and undamaged, ruling out a connector fault. The step at SC-05, its timing after closure re-entry, and the wavelength-dependent loss confirm a macrobend in the SC-05 slack.

args.evidence: Step Rx drop of ~2.75dB on 22 Oct coinciding with crew re-entry into SC-05 (22:33), OTDR shows single non-reflective step at fibre 18.753km from A / 2.796km from B = SC-05 (route 18.254km after fibre-excess conversion). Bidirectional-average loss rises steeply with wavelength: 0.51dB @1310, 2.81dB @1550, ~4.9dB @1625 — diagnostic of macrobend, not a bad splice. TX healthy (1.18dBm, stable bias/power), attenuator 7.14dB = design 7dB, connectors clean with ~0.2dB loss, SC-02 gainer/loss pair cancels bidirectionally (normal G.652/G.655 MFD mismatch). Excess link loss 2.74dB matches the 2.81dB 1550nm event. Corrective action: open SC-05, relieve the tight bend in the stored slack and re-coil correctly.

evidence_refs.quote: Splicing crew re-entered closure SC-05 to add a branch cable for a new customer. Closure resealed.
